SASBDB entry SASDV82  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDV82/)

Human haemoglobin (Sigma-Aldrich), 5 mg/ml, single concentration, 5 % (w/v) PEG 600 in
100 mM sodium phosphate pH 7.0 (member of the haemoglobin-PEG series; control SASDV62).
Publication: Baranova I, Angelova A, Stransky J, Andreasson J, Angelov B, "Hemoglobin-PEG
Interactions Probed by Small-Angle X-ray Scattering: Insights for Crystallization and
Diagnostics Applications", J Phys Chem B 2024 (published 2024 Sep 09),
DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c03003.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDV82.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files/SASDV82.dat (q in nm^-1)
  SASDV82_fit1_model1.pdb          NOT a SASDV82 file: SASDV82 has no fit and no model in
                                   SASBDB. This is a copy of the model of the control
                                   SASDV62 (SASDV62_fit2_model1.pdb from SASBDB, which
                                   SASBDB states is identical to PDB 3ODQ, human
                                   methaemoglobin crystal form; checked here: its 4384 ATOM
                                   records equal those of 3ODQ from files.rcsb.org). It is
                                   named "fit1" only to follow the layout of the other cases.
There is no deposited fit, so there is no reference curve.
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDV82/ states the conditions it takes from the
entry; the paper (PMC11440596) was read on 2026-11-13; see the script header.

Fit range (2026-11-13): the script cuts at q = 0.25 1/A (flat noise floor: above it 261 points, median I/sigma -0.12, 54 % I <= 0).
